top_choice_rationale: P001 most strongly combines foundational GLP-1 physiology with decades of mature, transformative therapeutic consequence in diabetes and obesity. The Holst-Mojsov-Drucker attribution is defensible only for a citation narrowly limited to discoveries that enabled the therapeutic principle, not all subsequent medicine development.
